title: End To End Testing Refactor
description: Implement the end-to-end testing refactor plan: make the nearest language-neutral domain owner the unit of test ownership. Deliver a new repo test domain (🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/🧪️test) owning taxonomy, Gherkin feature parsing, case discovery, scenario planning, oracle registry, native host protocols, result schemas, semantic comparison profiles, reporting, test-output cleanup and multi-ecosystem test dependency classification. Add Nx per-test-case project generation from **/🧪️tests/*/component.feature, native hosts for TypeScript/Rust/Go/Python/.NET, oracle-first development protocol, PDF pilots (pdf-writer creation oracle, lopdf editing oracle) on the ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🗿️artifacts/📄️pdf owner, safe `clean test`, taxonomy/testing policy breach families, multi-ecosystem dependency baseline with production reachability, CI gates, and launch.json entries. compose/** is a hard forbidden path for discovery, migration, cleaning, coverage and reports.
summary:
WAVE 6 — broadened the artifact oracle matrix and landed the first TypeScript subject differential that runs today.

18 cases, 66 executions, all passing, 40/40 parity. Oracle coverage 18/18. Platform self-tests 52 pass / 0 fail / 779 assertions.

FIVE MORE ARTIFACT FAMILIES, each against a real reference library: 🖼️bmp, 🖼️tiff and 📷️jpg via `image` 0.25 (one approved crate serving three formats rather than three), 🧊️obj via `tobj` 4, 🟪️stl via `stl_io` 0.8. Each scoped honestly to what the format actually fixes: BMP carries no alpha so the reference is given RGB; TIFF leaves compression, strip layout and byte order to the writer; JPEG is LOSSY so its projection reports geometry and a coarse luma histogram rather than exact pixels, because asserting byte-equal samples through a lossy codec is a test that can only pass by accident; OBJ has no reference WRITER so the oracle writes the grammar and tobj is the independent reader; STL is a triangle soup with no vertex index so the projection compares resolved corner positions. Fourteen registered oracles now, all classified test-oracle, production-reachable held at 151.

A THIRD FINDING FROM THE PURITY GATE. Registering `image` failed instantly with six breaches: the 🎞️animate plugin's video engine and 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🗺️surface's tiled-map both declare `image = "0.25"` as a PRODUCTION dependency. Confirmed real, not a false positive. Both call sites want raster decode/encode that ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio already implements, so both are Phase 7 targets; recorded as productionDebt with reachable paths, owning module and retirement plan, printed on every dependency run.

FIRST TYPESCRIPT SUBJECT DIFFERENTIAL. 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🎠️kernel owns versionSatisfies, a deliberate subset of the semver requirement grammar with the standard leading-zero caret tiers — a published contract, so `semver` 7.8.5 is a genuine oracle. 27 vectors across exact/any, caret at the major, minor AND patch tiers (^1.2.3, ^0.2.3, ^0.0.3 — where reimplementations most often diverge), tilde and at-least. This repository agrees with semver on every one: 2 cases, 7 executions, 3/3 parity, and it runs TODAY because the subject is TypeScript.

A DESIGN GAP THE RUN EXPOSED AND FIXED. The kernel case originally also carried a @mode-error scenario about this repository's own "unsatisfied, never a throw" law. A feature declares ONE oracle, so the coordinator ran the oracle role for that scenario too and reported it errored. The frozen contract was right and the feature was wrong — an error-law scenario is not the same capability as the differential one. Split into a sibling case `reject-malformed-version-input` under a recorded no-oracle decision, because semver THROWS on some malformed input and COERCES other malformed input to a match: a different and equally valid contract, so comparing against it would measure a deliberate divergence rather than a defect.

STILL BLOCKED, AND CHECKED AGAIN THIS WAVE. Every Rust subject still cannot compile: 📡️spr/🧵️channel now carries 60 `semio_framework::` references — Fault, FaultCode, FaultOrigin and the whole kernel:: module — while semio-framework itself depends on semio-framework-os-kernel. I verified there is no standalone diagnostic crate to depend on instead and that kernel:: also lives inside semio-framework, so the edge cannot be declared and the reference cannot be repointed. The fix is extracting those types into a lower crate or inverting the dependency, which belongs to the session doing that refactor. All 13 artifact subject handlers are written and gated behind the generated host's `sut` feature, and the metrics gate names the gap rather than hiding it.

Records: 📊️verification-wave6.txt.
